identityRules.contentId: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON (no whitespace, emit Unicode), an array sorted by URL UTF-8 bytes with tuples [url, role, bytes, sha256]. Times and HTTP diagnostic metadata do not participate. URL and role bind identity even when bytes are equal.
identityRules.captureId: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON of the whole object with captureId omitted; recursively lexically sorted object keys, no whitespace, emit Unicode, preserve array order. Includes capture times, sample observations and provenance.
identityRules.bodyHash: SHA-256 of decoded HTTP response entity bytes (transport content encoding removed), or direct Blob bytes. Multiple URLs may reference the same content address.

inputs.obtainedBy: HTTP GET with private application-key header, independent requests

discoveredFrom.stableRepresentation: worker:vsm-map denotes a Blob with no stable HTTP URL

bootstrapSelector.selection: The observed loader uses Math.random across suffixes 1, 2 and 3 when it selects its CDN host, builds scriptSDKV3 paths, then writes the versioned core and CSS in a standalone page. Preexisting Tmapvector/singleFile and loader state can change this branch.
bootstrapSelector.mobileNote: Mobile template loads the official bootstrap. These traces were captured in desktop Chrome; a particular mobile run requires its own network evidence.

browserMethod: New isolated headless Chrome contexts; UTF-8 HTML and exact verified authenticated bootstrap served from localhost; all vendor routes fetched normally. No vendor response override or Math.random override. Created a Seoul map at zoom 14 and observed ConfigLoad and browser worker launches. Worker URLs were matched to exact JS Blob bytes in memory; per-page ephemeral Blob locators were omitted.

charsetControl.purpose: DevTools response.body() for script text can re-encode using the document charset. Network entity bytes and browser-decoded text are tracked separately.
charsetControl.observedTransform: UTF-8 encoding after Windows-1252 decoding of the HTTP bytes exactly reproduces the control digest; all UTF-8 browser runs matched the HTTP bytes.

upstreamComparisons.newlyRecordedDefinition: Newly recorded URLs are capture-scope differences; they do not by themselves date an upstream addition.

testedExampleDependency.limitedScope: The recorded TData reverse-geocoding JSON callback used production core with official example-host jQuery 3.5.1; see paired reference observations for with/without-jQuery behavior. Do not infer every TData method requires it.

openDependencies.documentationIndexOtherScriptsScope: Found in index HTML; neither pinned as SDK runtime inputs nor tested for other examples. Query strings were omitted from this unverified discovery list.
openDependencies.runtimeScope: Initial map and worker startup only; lazy-loaded feature scripts, other render styles, authenticated service data, tiles, fonts, sprites, and application-specific code can depend on environment and actions. These are not covered as a complete dependency closure.

reproduction: GET each HTTP URL using its stated role. Supply the application key only via appKey request header on the authenticated bootstrap endpoint. Compare SHA-256 on HTTP entity bytes and byte count.

Serve the captured bootstrap in UTF-8 HTML. Allow external production script and stylesheet requests, create a map, observe ConfigLoad and worker events, and hash created Blob bytes. Never substitute fixture bytes for vendor requests when inspecting production CDN choice.

Independently reproduce contentId from the sorted input tuples, and captureId from this document without captureId. Timestamps should change on a fresh capture. Compare the content IDs and per-URL hashes to identify source changes.
